subject: eng
title: Grammar 2B Ch 5–6: Festivals, Seasons, Gerunds & Question Words

questions.q: People watch fireworks and get red packets ___ Chinese New Year.
questions.explain: 節日名稱（at Chinese New Year / at Christmas / at Easter / at Mid-Autumn Festival）前面用介詞 at。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: People watch fireworks and get red packets ___ Chinese New Year.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 5–6: Festivals, Seasons, Gerunds & Question Words

questions.q: ___ the second day of Chinese New Year, people watch fireworks.
questions.explain: 具體某一天（含 day 的日子，如 On the second day / On New Year's Day）前面用介詞 On。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ the second day of Chinese New Year, people watch fireworks.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 5–6: Festivals, Seasons, Gerunds & Question Words

questions.q: My brother Keith doesn't like swimming. He likes ___ his bicycle at weekends.
questions.explain: like 後面可接動名詞（gerund，即動詞 + -ing），ride 去 e 加 ing 變成 riding。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: My brother Keith doesn't like swimming. He likes ___ his bicycle at weekends.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 5–6: Festivals, Seasons, Gerunds & Question Words

questions.q: ___ do you like Mid-Autumn Festival? Because I like playing with lanterns.
questions.explain: 回答以 because 解釋原因，問句要用疑問詞 Why（為甚麼）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ do you like Mid-Autumn Festival? Because I like playing with lanterns.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 5–6: Festivals, Seasons, Gerunds & Question Words

questions.q: We usually eat hotpot in the evening ___ winter.
questions.explain: 季節（in spring / summer / autumn / winter）前面用介詞 in。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: We usually eat hotpot in the evening ___ winter.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 5–6: Festivals, Seasons, Gerunds & Question Words

questions.q: A: ___ teddy bear do you like best, the brown one or the grey one? B: I like the grey teddy bear best.
questions.explain: 在有限的特定選項中作選擇時，用疑問詞 Which（哪一個）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: A: ___ teddy bear do you like best, the brown one or the grey one? B: I like the grey teddy bear best.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 5–6: Festivals, Seasons, Gerunds & Question Words

questions.q: Fill in the correct form: Tina likes ___ (swim) in the sea in summer.
questions.explain: like + 動名詞（gerund），swim 是短元音加單輔音，雙寫 m 加 ing：swimming。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the correct form: Tina likes ___ (swim) in the sea in summer.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 5–6: Festivals, Seasons, Gerunds & Question Words

questions.q: Rearrange the words to form a question.
questions.explain: 詢問最喜歡哪個季節：Which season do you like best?
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Rearrange the words to form a question.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 5–6: Festivals, Seasons, Gerunds & Question Words
